limitations: Only pinned v2.28.2 is compared. Linux thread cases cover supplied typed byte adapters and one public Debian x64 sample, not all live races, exception formatting, resource limits or platform contracts.
Linux Intel32 discovery/translation is not established. Modern signal-list layout uses synthetic method vectors; no modern real-image thread differential is claimed.
Existing regex maxsize=4 Text/Hex failures remain unresolved, and the original Debian6.12 user image is unavailable.
No complete plugin contract is claimed.
